title: 矽像素粒子追蹤器~Silicon-pixel particle trackers
focus: MIP 訊號、空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、輻射損傷、物質量、讀出頻寬與軌跡式對準~MIP signal, depletion and Lorentz drift, radiation damage, material budget, readout bandwidth and track-based alignment
summary: 以 CMS 與 ALICE 的像素追蹤器為參照，從最小游離粒子在 285 µm 矽中釋放約兩萬兩千個電子出發，把空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、混合式與 MAPS 架構、輻射損傷、位置解析度、物質量、觸發緩衝與軌跡式對準串成一份可驗收、可交接的追蹤器工程紀錄。~Using the CMS and ALICE pixel trackers as references, start from the roughly 22,000 electrons a minimum-ionising particle frees in 285 µm of silicon, then connect depletion and Lorentz drift, hybrid versus MAPS architectures, radiation damage, spatial resolution, material budget, trigger buffering and track-based alignment into an acceptable, transferable tracker engineering record.

units.anchor: MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷~MIP ionisation track and signal charge
units.title: 最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號~Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal
units.mechanism: 帶電粒子穿過矽時以游離方式損失能量，最小游離粒子（MIP）的平均能損約 1.66 MeV·cm²/g，每產生一對電子—電洞需要 3.62 eV。少數高能 δ 電子會一次帶走大量能量，使能損分佈成為右尾很長的 Landau 分佈，最可能值只有平均值的約七成，因此門檻與信噪比必須用最可能值而非平均值設計。像素追蹤器的任務，就是在 LHC 25 ns 的束團間隔內把這數千到兩萬多個電子收集進讀出電路，並判斷它是否越過門檻。~A charged particle crossing silicon loses energy by ionisation; a minimum-ionising particle (MIP) deposits on average about 1.66 MeV·cm²/g, and each electron–hole pair costs 3.62 eV. A few energetic delta electrons occasionally carry away a large share of the energy, so the loss follows a Landau distribution with a long upper tail whose most probable value is only about 70% of the mean; thresholds and signal-to-noise must therefore be designed on the most probable value, not the mean. The pixel tracker's job is to collect these several thousand to twenty-odd thousand electrons into the readout circuit within the 25 ns LHC bunch spacing and decide whether they cross threshold.
units.model: 平均能損 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm，除以 3.62 eV 得平均約 107 對/µm；最可能值約 78 對/µm。285 µm 感測器：MPV ≈ 78 × 285 ≈ 22,200 e⁻ ≈ 3.6 fC，平均值約 30,500 e⁻。若前端雜訊為 120 e⁻ ENC、門檻 1,800 e⁻，則 MPV 信噪比 ≈ 185，門檻只佔 MPV 的 8%，同時是雜訊的 15 倍。~Mean loss 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm; dividing by 3.62 eV gives about 107 pairs/µm on average, with a most probable value near 78 pairs/µm. For a 285 µm sensor the MPV ≈ 78 × 285 ≈ 22,200 e⁻ ≈ 3.6 fC, while the mean is about 30,500 e⁻. With 120 e⁻ ENC front-end noise and a 1,800 e⁻ threshold, the MPV signal-to-noise is about 185 and the threshold is only 8% of the MPV yet 15 times the noise.
units.verify: 以 ⁹⁰Sr β 源（高能端電子近似 MIP）或測試束照射模組，先用讀出晶片內建的校正注入電容把 ToT 或 ADC 值換成電子數，再對叢集電荷擬合 Landau 與 Gauss 的摺積求 MPV 與寬度，與 22,000 e⁻ 的預期比較；同時在無照射時掃描門檻取得每個像素的 S 曲線，由其寬度求 ENC、由其中點求實際門檻分佈。~Irradiate the module with a ⁹⁰Sr beta source, whose high-energy electrons approximate MIPs, or with a test beam; first convert ToT or ADC values into electrons with the readout chip's built-in calibration-injection capacitor, then fit a Landau convolved with a Gaussian to the cluster charge to obtain MPV and width and compare with the expected 22,000 e⁻. Without beam, scan the threshold to obtain each pixel's S-curve, taking ENC from its width and the true threshold distribution from its midpoints.
units.failure: 若把平均值 30,500 e⁻ 當成設計值，門檻與增益看似留有大量餘裕；實際上落在 MPV 附近或更低的事件（斜入射把電荷分給相鄰像素、照射後電荷收集下降）會有一部分掉到門檻以下，命中效率從 99% 以上滑落，軌跡出現缺點，低動量軌跡的重建效率下降。~Designing on the 30,500 e⁻ mean makes threshold and gain look comfortably margined; in reality events near or below the MPV, such as inclined tracks sharing charge with neighbours or irradiated sensors collecting less, partly fall below threshold, hit efficiency slips from above 99%, tracks acquire missing hits and low-momentum reconstruction efficiency drops.
units.misconception: 每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。~Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed.

units.anchor: 反向偏壓空乏區~Reverse-biased depletion region
units.title: 空乏電壓、漂移時間與 Lorentz 角~Depletion voltage, drift time and the Lorentz angle
units.mechanism: 矽感測器是一個大面積的反向偏壓 p–n 二極體，只有空乏區內產生的電荷會在電場中漂移並在讀出電極感應出訊號，未空乏區的電荷只能慢慢擴散甚至被複合，所以感測器必須全空乏或至少讓集電側空乏。空乏深度隨偏壓的平方根增加，全空乏電壓與有效摻雜濃度及厚度平方成正比。在 CMS 3.8 T 螺線管磁場中，漂移的電子受 Lorentz 力偏轉，使電荷橫向散到相鄰像素；工程上反而利用這個偏轉做電荷分享內插。~A silicon sensor is a large-area reverse-biased p–n diode: only charge generated inside the depleted region drifts in the field and induces a signal on the readout electrode, whereas charge in undepleted silicon diffuses slowly or recombines, so the sensor must be fully depleted or at least depleted on the collecting side. Depletion depth grows with the square root of bias, and the full-depletion voltage scales with effective doping and the square of thickness. In the 3.8 T CMS solenoid field the drifting electrons are deflected by the Lorentz force and spread charge sideways into neighbouring pixels, an effect engineers exploit for charge-sharing interpolation.
units.model: V_d = q·N_eff·d²/(2ε)。3 kΩ·cm n 型矽 N_eff = 1/(q·µ_e·ρ) ≈ 1.5×10¹² cm⁻³，d = 285 µm，ε = 11.9ε₀ = 1.05×10⁻¹² F/cm：V_d ≈ 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ × 1.54×10¹² × (0.0285 cm)²/(2 × 1.05×10⁻¹²) ≈ 95 V。偏壓 150 V（平均場 5.3 kV/cm）並考慮速度飽和，電子漂移約 6 ns、電洞約 14 ns。Lorentz 角 tanθ_L = r_H·µ·B ≈ 1.15 × 0.096 m²/(V·s) × 3.8 T ≈ 0.42，θ_L ≈ 23°，穿過 285 µm 的橫向偏移約 120 µm。~V_d = q·N_eff·d²/(2ε). For 3 kΩ·cm n-type silicon N_eff = 1/(q·µ_e·ρ) ≈ 1.5×10¹² cm⁻³; with d = 285 µm and ε = 11.9ε₀ = 1.05×10⁻¹² F/cm, V_d ≈ 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ × 1.54×10¹² × (0.0285 cm)²/(2 × 1.05×10⁻¹²) ≈ 95 V. At 150 V bias (mean field 5.3 kV/cm), including velocity saturation, electrons drift for about 6 ns and holes for about 14 ns. The Lorentz angle is tanθ_L = r_H·µ·B ≈ 1.15 × 0.096 m²/(V·s) × 3.8 T ≈ 0.42, θ_L ≈ 23°, a lateral shift of about 120 µm across 285 µm.
units.verify: 量 C–V 曲線：1/C² 對偏壓先線性上升，到全空乏處轉平，轉折點即 V_d；同時量 I–V 確認崩潰電壓遠高於工作點。Lorentz 角在磁場中以入射角掃描量測：叢集寬度對入射角的曲線最小值所在的角度就是 Lorentz 角，與 r_H·µ·B 的預測比較，並在每次改變偏壓後重做。~Measure the C–V curve: 1/C² rises linearly with bias and flattens at full depletion, and the knee gives V_d; measure I–V at the same time to confirm that breakdown lies well above the operating point. Measure the Lorentz angle in field by scanning the incidence angle: the angle at which cluster width versus incidence reaches its minimum is the Lorentz angle, which is compared with the r_H·µ·B prediction and re-measured whenever the bias changes.
units.failure: 偏壓不足時集電側以外留有未空乏層，電荷收集變慢且部分被複合，訊號下降並出現落在下一個 25 ns 時窗的晚到命中；若重建沿用錯誤的 Lorentz 偏移，所有命中位置系統性偏移數十 µm，在桶部兩個方向相反的模組上產生方向相反的殘差。~With insufficient bias an undepleted layer remains beyond the collecting side, charge collection slows and partly recombines, the signal drops and late hits spill into the next 25 ns window; if reconstruction keeps a wrong Lorentz shift, every hit is displaced by tens of micrometres, producing opposite residuals on barrel modules mounted in opposite orientations.
units.misconception: 只要接上偏壓，整片感測器就全部是靈敏區，空乏深度與偏壓無關。~Once bias is applied the whole sensor is sensitive, and depletion depth does not depend on voltage.

units.anchor: 感測器、凸塊與讀出晶片~Sensor, bump bonds and readout chip
units.title: 混合式像素與單體式 MAPS 架構~Hybrid pixels versus monolithic MAPS
units.mechanism: 混合式像素把高阻值感測器與 CMOS 讀出晶片分開製造，再以每像素一顆的焊錫或銦凸塊倒裝接合，因此感測器可採 n-in-n 或 n-in-p 的抗輻射設計，讀出晶片可用先進製程；CMS Phase-1 像素為 100×150 µm²、285 µm 厚，每顆讀出晶片 52×80 像素。單體式主動像素感測器（MAPS）把電荷收集層與前端電路做在同一片晶圓上，例如 ALICE ITS2 的 ALPIDE 以 180 nm CMOS 影像感測製程製作約 29×27 µm² 的像素並薄化到 50 µm，省去凸塊與第二層矽；代價是電荷主要來自數十微米的磊晶層，抗輻射能力與時間解析度不如混合式。~Hybrid pixels fabricate a high-resistivity sensor and a CMOS readout chip separately and flip-chip join them with one solder or indium bump per pixel, so the sensor can use radiation-hard n-in-n or n-in-p designs while the readout chip uses an advanced process; CMS Phase-1 pixels are 100×150 µm², 285 µm thick, with 52×80 pixels per readout chip. Monolithic active pixel sensors (MAPS) put the charge-collecting layer and front-end circuit in the same wafer; ALICE ITS2's ALPIDE uses a 180 nm CMOS imaging process with pixels of about 29×27 µm² thinned to 50 µm, eliminating bumps and a second silicon layer, at the cost of collecting charge mainly from an epitaxial layer tens of micrometres thick and having lower radiation tolerance and timing performance than hybrids.
units.model: 面積比 (100×150)/(29.24×26.88) ≈ 19；二元解析度 100/√12 ≈ 28.9 µm 對 29.24/√12 ≈ 8.4 µm。物質量（矽 X₀ = 9.37 cm）：285 µm 感測器 ≈ 0.30% X₀，175 µm 讀出晶片 ≈ 0.19% X₀；50 µm MAPS 僅 ≈ 0.053% X₀。MAPS 收集電極電容約 5 fF，1,300 e⁻ 產生 ΔV = Q/C ≈ 42 mV，可用極低功耗的像素內放大器判斷；混合式輸入電容約 150 fF，需要電荷靈敏放大器。~Area ratio (100×150)/(29.24×26.88) ≈ 19; binary resolution 100/√12 ≈ 28.9 µm versus 29.24/√12 ≈ 8.4 µm. Material (silicon X₀ = 9.37 cm): a 285 µm sensor is ≈ 0.30% X₀ and a 175 µm readout chip ≈ 0.19% X₀, whereas a 50 µm MAPS is only ≈ 0.053% X₀. A MAPS collection electrode of about 5 fF turns 1,300 e⁻ into ΔV = Q/C ≈ 42 mV, enough for a very low-power in-pixel amplifier; a hybrid input of about 150 fF needs a charge-sensitive amplifier.
units.verify: 混合式模組以放射源或 X 光全面照射建立凸塊連通圖，並比較偏壓開與關時每個像素的雜訊差，找出斷開或短路的凸塊；MAPS 在測試束量效率與假命中率對門檻的曲線，確認在效率高於 99% 的門檻下，假命中率低於每像素每事件 10⁻⁶。~For hybrid modules, illuminate the whole module with a source or X-rays to map bump connectivity and compare each pixel's noise with bias on and off to locate open or shorted bumps; for MAPS, measure efficiency and fake-hit rate versus threshold in a test beam and confirm that at a threshold giving above 99% efficiency the fake-hit rate stays below 10⁻⁶ per pixel per event.
units.failure: 凸塊在熱循環中因感測器與讀出晶片的熱應變差而開裂，該像素變成死像素，雜訊反而下降，若只用雜訊判斷健康就會漏抓；MAPS 若磊晶層太薄或反向偏壓不足，電荷擴散到多個像素後各自低於門檻，效率下降且叢集形狀異常。~Bumps crack under thermal cycling because of differential strain between sensor and readout chip, turning the pixel dead while its noise actually falls, so a noise-only health check misses it; in MAPS a thin epitaxial layer or insufficient reverse bias lets charge diffuse over several pixels that each stay below threshold, lowering efficiency and distorting cluster shapes.
units.misconception: MAPS 只是把混合式像素做得更薄，輻射硬度與時間解析度完全相同。~MAPS are simply thinner hybrid pixels with identical radiation hardness and timing.

units.anchor: 感測器漏電流與冷卻迴路~Sensor leakage current and cooling loop
units.title: 輻射損傷、漏電流與熱失控~Radiation damage, leakage current and thermal runaway
units.mechanism: 強子與高能粒子在矽晶格中造成位移損傷，以 1 MeV 中子等效通量 Φ_eq 計量，產生能隙中間的缺陷能階，帶來三種後果：漏電流依 ΔI = α·Φ_eq·V 線性增加；有效摻雜改變，使 n 型基體發生型別反轉並讓空乏電壓持續上升；以及載子被缺陷捕獲使收集電荷下降。漏電流依 T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) 強烈依賴溫度，約每降 7 K 減半，所以內層像素必須冷到攝氏零下十到二十度；漏電流發熱又會加熱感測器，冷卻不足就會形成熱失控。~Hadrons and energetic particles cause displacement damage in the silicon lattice, quantified by the 1 MeV neutron-equivalent fluence Φ_eq, creating mid-gap defect levels with three consequences: leakage current rises linearly as ΔI = α·Φ_eq·V; effective doping changes, inverting n-type bulk and steadily raising the depletion voltage; and carriers are trapped, reducing collected charge. Leakage follows T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) and roughly halves for every 7 K of cooling, so inner pixel layers must run at −10 to −20 °C; because the leakage current itself heats the sensor, insufficient cooling leads to thermal runaway.
units.model: α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm（20 °C、退火後）。100×150×285 µm³ 像素體積 4.28×10⁻⁶ cm³，Φ_eq = 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻² 時 20 °C 漏電流 ≈ 171 nA；換到 −10 °C 乘以 (263/293)²·exp[−1.21 eV/(2k_B)·(1/263 − 1/293)] ≈ 0.053，約 9 nA。66,560 像素的模組約 0.6 mA，400 V 偏壓下發熱 0.24 W。型別反轉後 N_eff ≈ g_c·Φ ≈ 1.5×10¹³ cm⁻³，285 µm 的空乏電壓升到約 930 V，超過偏壓上限，只能部分空乏運作。~α ≈ 4×10⁻¹⁷ A/cm at 20 °C after annealing. A 100×150×285 µm³ pixel has a volume of 4.28×10⁻⁶ cm³, so at Φ_eq = 1×10¹⁵ cm⁻² it leaks about 171 nA at 20 °C; scaling to −10 °C multiplies by (263/293)²·exp[−1.21 eV/(2k_B)·(1/263 − 1/293)] ≈ 0.053, about 9 nA. A 66,560-pixel module then draws about 0.6 mA and dissipates 0.24 W at 400 V. After inversion N_eff ≈ g_c·Φ ≈ 1.5×10¹³ cm⁻³ and the 285 µm depletion voltage climbs to about 930 V, beyond the bias limit, so the sensor runs partially depleted.
units.verify: 運轉期間定期量 I–V，把電流換算到 20 °C 再除以感測器體積，畫漏電流對累積亮度或模擬通量的直線，斜率應與 α 相符；以偏壓掃描量叢集電荷對偏壓的曲線求有效空乏電壓，決定何時提高偏壓；再比對各模組溫度感測值與漏電流的溫度相依性，找出熱接觸不良的模組。~During operation take periodic I–V scans, normalise the current to 20 °C and divide by sensor volume, and plot leakage against integrated luminosity or simulated fluence, expecting a slope consistent with α; use bias scans of cluster charge versus voltage to find the effective depletion voltage and decide when to raise bias; compare each module's temperature readings with the temperature dependence of its leakage to identify modules with poor thermal contact.
units.failure: 冷卻板與模組間的導熱膠脫層時，局部溫度升高約 7 K 就讓漏電流加倍，發熱再推高溫度，最終電源電流達上限而跳脫，該模組退出運轉；若偏壓未隨空乏電壓上升而調高，收集電荷持續下降，效率先在最內層崩落。~When the thermal adhesive between cooling plate and module delaminates, a local rise of about 7 K doubles the leakage, the extra heat raises temperature further, and the supply eventually hits its current limit and trips, removing the module; if bias is not raised as the depletion voltage climbs, collected charge keeps falling and efficiency collapses first in the innermost layer.
units.misconception: 漏電流只取決於累積的輻射劑量，與運轉溫度無關。~Leakage current depends only on accumulated radiation dose, not on operating temperature.

units.anchor: 電荷分享叢集與測試束望遠鏡~Charge-sharing cluster and beam telescope
units.title: 空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束~Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams
units.mechanism: 若每顆粒子只點亮一個像素，位置誤差在節距內均勻分佈，解析度為 p/√12；當電荷因 Lorentz 偏移、斜入射或擴散分到兩個像素時，用類比電荷資訊（ADC 或 ToT）做重心或 η 修正內插，解析度可比二元讀出好約三倍。良好的電荷分享需要低門檻與低雜訊，否則邊緣像素的小訊號會被切掉，叢集退化成單像素。驗證解析度需要比待測元件更準的參考，也就是由數層薄 MAPS 組成的測試束望遠鏡。~If each particle fires only one pixel, the position error is uniformly distributed across the pitch and the resolution is p/√12; when charge is shared between two pixels through Lorentz drift, inclined incidence or diffusion, interpolating with analogue charge (ADC or ToT) by centre of gravity or an eta correction improves on binary readout by about a factor of three. Good sharing requires low threshold and low noise, otherwise the small signal in the edge pixel is cut and the cluster collapses to a single pixel. Verifying resolution needs a reference more precise than the device under test, which is a beam telescope built from several thin MAPS planes.
units.model: 二元：σ = p/√12 = 100/3.46 ≈ 28.9 µm（rφ）、150/3.46 ≈ 43.3 µm（z）。利用 Lorentz 分享後 rφ 可達約 10 µm。測試束量得殘差寬度 σ_res = 10.5 µm、望遠鏡外插誤差 σ_tel = 3.0 µm，則 σ_DUT = √(σ_res² − σ_tel²) = √(110.25 − 9) ≈ 10.1 µm；若忽略望遠鏡項，等於把解析度高估約 4%。~Binary: σ = p/√12 = 100/3.46 ≈ 28.9 µm in rφ and 150/3.46 ≈ 43.3 µm in z. With Lorentz sharing, rφ reaches about 10 µm. If the test beam gives a residual width σ_res = 10.5 µm and the telescope extrapolation error is σ_tel = 3.0 µm, then σ_DUT = √(σ_res² − σ_tel²) = √(110.25 − 9) ≈ 10.1 µm; ignoring the telescope term overstates the error by about 4%.
units.verify: 在 DESY 或 CERN SPS 測試束，把待測模組放在 EUDET 型望遠鏡中間，以旋轉台掃描入射角，記錄叢集尺寸與殘差對角度的關係；分別對叢集大小 1、2、3 以上的事件求殘差，確認多數事件為雙像素叢集，並畫像素內效率圖，檢查角落與凸塊附近的效率損失。~At the DESY or CERN SPS test beam, place the module under test in the middle of an EUDET-type telescope, scan the incidence angle on a rotation stage, and record cluster size and residual versus angle; compute residuals separately for cluster sizes 1, 2 and 3 or more, confirm that most events are two-pixel clusters, and map in-pixel efficiency to check for losses at corners and near the bump.
units.failure: 照射後電荷收集下降，邊緣像素的分享電荷跌到門檻以下，叢集變小，解析度從約 10 µm 退回接近二元值；若重建仍用照射前的 η 修正表，誤差還會帶有隨入射角變化的系統偏移。~After irradiation, reduced charge collection pushes the shared charge in edge pixels below threshold, clusters shrink and resolution degrades from about 10 µm towards the binary value; if reconstruction still uses the pre-irradiation eta-correction tables, the error also carries an angle-dependent systematic offset.
units.misconception: 解析度就等於像素節距，100 µm 節距不可能量到 10 µm 的位置。~Resolution equals the pixel pitch, so a 100 µm pitch cannot measure position to 10 µm.

units.anchor: 每層物質量與束管~Per-layer material and beam pipe
units.title: 物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數~Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter
units.mechanism: 追蹤器每一層的矽、讀出晶片、冷卻管、碳纖維支撐與電纜都會讓粒子發生多重庫侖散射，散射角寬度依 Highland 公式與 √(x/X₀) 成正比、與動量成反比。低動量粒子的撞擊參數與頂點解析度通常由物質量而非像素解析度決定，所以內層設計的競賽是降低 X/X₀ 並縮小第一層半徑；只有在高動量時才回到幾何項，由命中解析度與層間槓桿臂決定。~Every layer's silicon, readout chips, cooling pipes, carbon-fibre supports and cables cause multiple Coulomb scattering, with an angular width that by the Highland formula scales as √(x/X₀) and inversely with momentum. For low-momentum particles the impact-parameter and vertex resolution is usually set by material rather than by pixel resolution, so inner-layer design becomes a contest to cut X/X₀ and shrink the first-layer radius; only at high momentum does the geometric term, set by hit resolution and the lever arm between layers, dominate again.
units.model: θ₀ = (13.6 MeV/p)·√(x/X₀)·[1 + 0.038 ln(x/X₀)]。x/X₀ = 1.0%、p = 1 GeV/c：θ₀ ≈ 1.12 mrad，在 r₁ = 29 mm 的第一層貢獻 ≈ 29 mm × 1.12 mrad ≈ 33 µm。兩層幾何項 σ·√(r₁² + r₂²)/(r₂ − r₁)，σ = 10 µm、r₂ = 68 mm 得 19 µm；合計 √(33² + 19²) ≈ 38 µm。若每層降到 0.35% X₀，θ₀ ≈ 0.63 mrad，合計約 26 µm；在 10 GeV/c 時散射項只剩 3 µm，總和約 19 µm。~θ₀ = (13.6 MeV/p)·√(x/X₀)·[1 + 0.038 ln(x/X₀)]. For x/X₀ = 1.0% and p = 1 GeV/c, θ₀ ≈ 1.12 mrad, contributing ≈ 29 mm × 1.12 mrad ≈ 33 µm at a first layer of radius r₁ = 29 mm. The two-layer geometric term σ·√(r₁² + r₂²)/(r₂ − r₁) with σ = 10 µm and r₂ = 68 mm gives 19 µm, for a total of √(33² + 19²) ≈ 38 µm. Cutting each layer to 0.35% X₀ gives θ₀ ≈ 0.63 mrad and a total near 26 µm; at 10 GeV/c the scattering term is only 3 µm and the total is about 19 µm.
units.verify: 以光子轉換頂點與強子交互作用頂點的空間分佈做物質層析，把重建頂點密度換算成 X/X₀ 對半徑與偽快度的分佈，與幾何模擬的物質量逐區比較；另把撞擊參數解析度對 p_T 的曲線擬合成 a ⊕ b/p_T，a 對應幾何項、b 對應散射項，與設計值比對。~Use the spatial distribution of photon-conversion and hadronic-interaction vertices as material tomography, converting vertex density into X/X₀ versus radius and pseudorapidity and comparing region by region with the simulated geometry; fit the impact-parameter resolution versus p_T as a ⊕ b/p_T, where a is the geometric term and b the scattering term, and compare both with the design.
units.failure: 模擬漏算冷卻液、連接器或電纜，實際物質量多出 20 到 30%，低 p_T 軌跡的誤差被低估，軌跡 χ² 分佈偏寬，b 夸克標記的效率與誤判率偏離模擬，使物理分析帶入未被察覺的系統誤差。~Simulation that omits coolant, connectors or cables underestimates material by 20 to 30%, so low-p_T track errors are underestimated, track χ² distributions broaden, and b-tagging efficiency and mistag rates drift from simulation, injecting unnoticed systematics into physics analyses.
units.misconception: 像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。~Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material.

units.anchor: 雙欄緩衝與資料鏈路~Double-column buffers and data links
units.title: 命中率、觸發延遲緩衝與讀出頻寬~Hit rate, trigger-latency buffering and readout bandwidth
units.mechanism: 內層像素的命中率大致隨半徑按 1/r² 增加，在高亮度下達每平方公分數百 MHz。觸發式讀出必須把每個命中保留到第一級觸發決定到來（CMS 約 4 µs），讀出晶片以雙欄為單位暫存時間戳記與電荷，緩衝滿了新命中就遺失；被觸發的事件再經串列鏈路送出，鏈路頻寬決定可承受的觸發率。因此系統效率損失不只來自感測器，也來自數位架構的死時間與緩衝溢位。~Inner-layer hit rates rise roughly as 1/r² with radius, reaching hundreds of MHz per square centimetre at high luminosity. Triggered readout must hold every hit until the first-level trigger decision arrives, about 4 µs at CMS; the readout chip buffers timestamps and charge per double column and loses new hits once the buffer is full, and triggered events then leave over serial links whose bandwidth sets the sustainable trigger rate. System inefficiency therefore comes not only from the sensor but also from dead time and buffer overflow in the digital architecture.
units.model: 假設命中率 200 MHz/cm²（教學值）、像素 100×150 µm²：每次束團交叉每像素佔用率 = 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴。一個 160 像素的雙欄（0.024 cm²）命中率 4.8 MHz，4 µs 延遲內平均暫存 19.2 筆；依 Poisson 分佈，32 格緩衝的溢位機率約 0.26%，24 格則約 11.6%。每顆 0.62 cm² 讀出晶片每次交叉 3.1 個命中，100 kHz 觸發、每命中 24 bit 約 7.5 Mbit/s，尚不含標頭。~Assume 200 MHz/cm² (teaching value) and 100×150 µm² pixels: the per-pixel occupancy per bunch crossing is 2×10⁸ × 25×10⁻⁹ × 1.5×10⁻⁴ ≈ 7.5×10⁻⁴. A 160-pixel double column (0.024 cm²) sees 4.8 MHz and holds on average 19.2 hits during a 4 µs latency; by Poisson statistics a 32-slot buffer overflows with probability about 0.26% and a 24-slot buffer about 11.6%. Each 0.62 cm² readout chip sees 3.1 hits per crossing, so a 100 kHz trigger at 24 bits per hit needs about 7.5 Mbit/s before headers.
units.verify: 以 X 光管或高強度束流在不同命中率下量效率，畫效率對命中率曲線並與 Poisson 緩衝模型比較；運轉時監控觸發後的命中數、鏈路錯誤計數與 FIFO 滿旗標，確認在設計亮度下由緩衝與死時間造成的效率損失低於 1%。~Measure efficiency at several hit rates with an X-ray tube or high-intensity beam and compare the efficiency-versus-rate curve with the Poisson buffer model; during operation monitor hits per trigger, link error counters and FIFO-full flags, confirming that buffer and dead-time losses stay below 1% at design luminosity.
units.failure: 亮度提高後最內層的雙欄緩衝溢位，效率下降數個百分比，且損失集中在高佔用率、高堆疊的事件，造成與亮度相關的系統偏差；這正是高亮度升級時讀出晶片要加大緩衝並改用高速數位鏈路的主要理由之一。~As luminosity rises the innermost double-column buffers overflow and efficiency drops by several percent, concentrated in high-occupancy, high-pile-up events, creating a luminosity-dependent bias; this is one of the main reasons high-luminosity upgrades enlarge readout-chip buffers and move to fast digital links.
units.misconception: 感測器效率 99.9%，整個像素系統的效率就是 99.9%。~If the sensor is 99.9% efficient, the whole pixel system is 99.9% efficient.

units.anchor: 軌跡殘差與對準參數~Track residuals and alignment parameters
units.title: 軌跡式對準、弱模態與試運轉交接~Track-based alignment, weak modes and commissioning handoff
units.mechanism: 安裝後模組位置只知道到數十微米，遠差於約 10 µm 的命中解析度，所以最終幾何由大量軌跡決定：把每個模組的三個平移與三個轉動當作參數，與軌跡參數一起最小化殘差 χ²，例如 Millepede-II 的全域擬合。某些整體變形如扭轉、伸縮與弓形，讓所有軌跡仍然擬合良好卻系統性地偏移動量，稱為弱模態，只能靠宇宙射線、束暈軌跡或 Z→μμ 質量約束打破。試運轉交接必須包含幾何版本、Lorentz 角、門檻與遮罩像素表以及對準驗證圖。~After installation module positions are known only to tens of micrometres, far worse than the roughly 10 µm hit resolution, so the final geometry is determined from many tracks: each module's three translations and three rotations become parameters minimised together with track parameters in a residual χ², for example in a Millepede-II global fit. Certain global deformations such as twist, telescope and bowing leave every track well fitted yet bias momentum systematically; these weak modes are broken only with cosmic rays, beam-halo tracks or Z→μμ mass constraints. The commissioning handoff must include the geometry version, Lorentz angle, thresholds and masked-pixel tables, and alignment validation plots.
units.model: 每模組統計精度約 σ_hit/√N：σ_hit = 10 µm，要達 1 µm 需約 100 條穿越軌跡（再乘幾何因子）。CMS 追蹤器約 17,000 個模組 × 6 自由度 ≈ 10⁵ 個參數。弓高 s = L²/(8R)，R = p_T/(0.3B)：p_T = 45 GeV/c、B = 3.8 T 得 R ≈ 39.5 m；L = 1.1 m 時 s ≈ 3.8 mm，10 µm 的系統弓高偏差造成約 0.26% 的動量偏差，且正負電荷方向相反。~Per-module statistical precision is about σ_hit/√N: with σ_hit = 10 µm, reaching 1 µm needs about 100 crossing tracks, times a geometric factor. The CMS tracker's roughly 17,000 modules × 6 degrees of freedom give about 10⁵ parameters. Sagitta s = L²/(8R) with R = p_T/(0.3B): p_T = 45 GeV/c and B = 3.8 T give R ≈ 39.5 m, and L = 1.1 m gives s ≈ 3.8 mm, so a 10 µm systematic sagitta bias shifts momentum by about 0.26%, with opposite sign for opposite charges.
units.verify: 畫各模組殘差中位數的分佈（DMR），對準後寬度應遠小於命中解析度；把宇宙射線分成上下兩半各自重建並比較軌跡參數差；檢查 Z→μμ 重建質量對方位角、偽快度與電荷的相依性以找出弱模態；交接文件列出幾何版本、偏壓與溫度、門檻與遮罩表及上述驗證圖。~Plot the distribution of per-module median residuals (DMR), whose width after alignment should be far below the hit resolution; split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, reconstruct each, and compare track-parameter differences; check the dependence of the reconstructed Z→μμ mass on azimuth, pseudorapidity and charge to expose weak modes; the handoff document lists geometry version, bias and temperature, thresholds and mask tables, and these validation plots.
units.failure: 只用對撞軌跡對準時殘差看起來完美，卻殘留扭轉弱模態，使正負電荷的動量出現相反偏差，μ⁺ 與 μ⁻ 的質量峰錯開；熱循環或磁場開關後若未重做對準，模組數微米的位移也會讓撞擊參數解析度悄悄變差。~Aligning with collision tracks alone can give perfect-looking residuals while leaving a twist weak mode that biases positive and negative momenta in opposite directions and separates the μ⁺ and μ⁻ mass peaks; if alignment is not redone after thermal cycles or magnet ramps, module shifts of a few micrometres silently degrade impact-parameter resolution.
units.misconception: 殘差分佈置中且很窄，就代表追蹤器幾何已完全正確。~Centred, narrow residual distributions prove the tracker geometry is completely correct.

example: 內層模組設計練習：假設高亮度型內層採 50×50 µm² 像素、150 µm 厚感測器與 400×384 像素的讀出晶片。薄感測器取最可能值 72 e⁻/µm，訊號 MPV ≈ 72 × 150 = 10,800 e⁻；門檻 1,000 e⁻ 為 MPV 的 9.3%，雜訊 80 e⁻ 時門檻與雜訊比為 12.5。二元解析度 50/√12 ≈ 14.4 µm；感測器物質量 150/93,700 ≈ 0.16% X₀。未照射時 3 kΩ·cm 基材的空乏電壓按 d² 縮放為 95 × (150/285)² ≈ 26 V；照射到 Φ_eq = 2×10¹⁵ cm⁻² 後 N_eff ≈ 3×10¹³ cm⁻³，空乏電壓約 510 V。每像素體積 3.75×10⁻⁷ cm³，20 °C 漏電流 = 4×10⁻¹⁷ × 2×10¹⁵ × 3.75×10⁻⁷ = 30 nA，冷到 −15 °C 乘以 0.030 得 0.90 nA；整顆晶片 153,600 像素約 0.14 mA，500 V 偏壓下約 0.07 W。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實驗的規格。~Inner-module design exercise: assume a high-luminosity inner layer with 50×50 µm² pixels, a 150 µm sensor and a 400×384-pixel readout chip. Taking a most probable 72 e⁻/µm for thin sensors, the signal MPV ≈ 72 × 150 = 10,800 e⁻; a 1,000 e⁻ threshold is 9.3% of the MPV, and with 80 e⁻ noise the threshold-to-noise ratio is 12.5. Binary resolution is 50/√12 ≈ 14.4 µm and sensor material is 150/93,700 ≈ 0.16% X₀. Unirradiated 3 kΩ·cm bulk depletes at 95 × (150/285)² ≈ 26 V by d² scaling; after Φ_eq = 2×10¹⁵ cm⁻², N_eff ≈ 3×10¹³ cm⁻³ and the depletion voltage is about 510 V. Each pixel has a volume of 3.75×10⁻⁷ cm³, so leakage at 20 °C is 4×10⁻¹⁷ × 2×10¹⁵ × 3.75×10⁻⁷ = 30 nA, and cooling to −15 °C multiplies by 0.030 to give 0.90 nA; the 153,600-pixel chip draws about 0.14 mA, about 0.07 W at 500 V. Values are teaching assumptions, not any experiment's specification.
history: 混合式像素偵測器在 1990 年代由 CERN 的 RD19 等研發計畫推動，先在固定靶與 LEP 實驗中運轉，2008 年起 ATLAS 與 CMS 以數千萬像素的混合式系統成為 LHC 的最內層追蹤器，CMS 的像素系統由 PSI 等機構主導建造，並於 2017 年升級為四層的 Phase-1 偵測器。單體式 MAPS 源自可見光 CMOS 影像感測器，2014 年在 RHIC 的 STAR 首次用於對撞機頂點偵測器，2022 年 ALICE ITS2 以約 125 億像素、10 m² 的 ALPIDE 投入運轉。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~Hybrid pixel detectors were developed in the 1990s by CERN research programmes such as RD19 and first operated in fixed-target and LEP experiments; from 2008 ATLAS and CMS ran hybrid systems with tens of millions of pixels as the LHC's innermost trackers, the CMS pixel system being built under the lead of PSI and partners and upgraded to the four-layer Phase-1 detector in 2017. Monolithic MAPS grew out of visible-light CMOS image sensors, served first in a collider vertex detector at STAR at RHIC in 2014, and in 2022 ALICE ITS2 began operation with about 12.5 billion ALPIDE pixels over 10 m². This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
